verdict: Lead volume surged this period; cost per lead dropped significantly.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 21 tracked leads at a cost of $156.73 per lead — a 44% improvement in efficiency compared to the prior week. Meta drove all 21 attributed leads on $920 in spend, while Google's Local Services campaign absorbed the majority of your $2,371 Google budget and is generating activity that is not yet fully captured in lead counts. Attribution across your intake pipeline is being repaired now, as a meaningful number of contacts are entering your system without a clear ad source attached — once that is resolved, reported lead totals will better reflect actual intake volume. Expect cleaner numbers and a fuller picture of Google's contribution in the next reporting period.
